title: Shrek
short: Six films including Puss in Boots
blurb: Four films about an ogre and two about the cat who joins him in the second — one of which is set before they met.

pb22.t: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

note: Puss in Boots is a prequel showing how the character earned his reputation before turning up in Shrek 2. The Last Wish is a straight sequel to it and much the better film.
